product_family: AI-powered hiring platform: Skills Validation (Virtual Job Tryouts, assessments), Intelligent Interviewing (video interviewing, HV4), Talent Engagement, and Workflow Automation, delivered via the Video Intelligence Platform (VIP) and Text-to-Outcome (T2O) solutions

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: HireVue undergoes an annual SOC 2 Type 2 audit covering all Trust Services Criteria: Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy.

certifications.name: SOC 3
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 3 report listed as an available trust document alongside SOC 2 Type 2 on the Hirevue Trust Center.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 for Information Security Management ... These certifications apply to both their VIP and T2O solutions.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27701:2019 (Privacy Information Management)
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27701:2019 for Privacy Information Management, with these certifications applying to both their VIP and T2O solutions.

certifications.name: FedRAMP (Moderate)
certifications.proof_quote: FedRAMP—The only FedRAMP-authorised hiring solution for the public sector—ensuring the highest security and compliance standards.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture / compliance summary)
certifications.proof_quote: GDPR Summary listed as a compliance document on the Hirevue Trust Center; Privacy Notice describes EU/UK data subject rights, international transfer mechanisms and lawful bases under GDPR.

certifications.name: EU-US Data Privacy Framework (incl. UK Extension, Swiss-US DPF)
certifications.proof_quote: EU-US DPF ... Swiss-US DPF ... UK Extension to EU-US DPF listed among Hirevue Trust Center certifications; Privacy Notice references the Data Privacy Framework for international transfers.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a HIPAA attestation or BAA program on the trust center, security page, or legal center. HireVue is a hiring/recruiting platform, not a healthcare product, so HIPAA is out of scope for its core service.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a PCI DSS attestation on the trust center or security page; payment data collection (per the Privacy Notice) appears limited to billing and is not a core product function.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management System)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO/IEC 42001 certification on the trust center. HireVue instead documents AI governance via its own AI Ethical Principles and HV4/T2O Explainability Statements rather than a third-party AI management certification.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a CSA STAR registry entry or CAIQ publication beyond an internal reference to "CAIQ" as a trust-center artifact; not independently confirmed as a published CSA STAR listing.

privacy.ai_training_note: HireVue's assessment algorithms are built by HireVue data scientists and I/O psychologists using HireVue's own historical, validated assessment data on a per-role basis (per the AI Ethical Principles document), not generic web-scraped or third-party data. It is not explicitly and publicly documented on the trust center or privacy pages whether an individual customer's ongoing candidate interview data is fed back into training future models, so this is recorded as unconfirmed rather than assumed. Candidates are given notice that AI is used and can opt out in favor of 100% human review, per HireVue's public AI Explainability Statement materials.

security.name: SOC 2 Type 2 audit scope
security.value: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 audit covering Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy Trust Services Criteria.

security.name: Cloud infrastructure
security.value: Hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS); specific region/residency detail not published in captured pages.

security.name: Federal authorization
security.value: FedRAMP Moderate authorization (Class C), first granted 5/10/2019, with ongoing Continuous Monitoring; listed on the official FedRAMP Marketplace.

security.name: Legal / contractual security artifacts
security.value: Master Services Agreement, Data Processing Addendum, Warrant Canary, Approved Subprocessors list, and an Information Security Trust Portal are all published in HireVue's Legal Center.

security.name: AI governance documentation
security.value: Publishes AI Ethical Principles and per-product (HV4, T2O) Explainability Statements describing model development, bias testing, and candidate opt-out to human review.

products.name: Skills Validation (Virtual Job Tryouts / assessments)
products.data_scope: Candidate assessment responses, game-based task performance, demographic data used for adverse-impact/bias testing.
products.notes: Per-role, purpose-built scoring models developed by HireVue's I/O psychology and data science teams; falls under HV4/T2O Explainability Statements.

products.name: Intelligent Interviewing (Video Interviewing, HV4)
products.data_scope: Candidate video/audio recordings, interview responses, AI-assisted scoring metadata.
products.notes: Candidates receive notice of AI use and may opt for 100% human review instead of AI scoring, per HireVue's AI Explainability Statement.

products.name: Talent Engagement
products.notes: 24/7 automated candidate engagement; lower sensitivity data scope than assessment/video products.

products.name: Workflow Automation / Scheduling
products.data_scope: Scheduling, calendar, and ATS-integration data (identity/contact data, not assessment content).
products.notes: Integrates with customer ATS systems; described as reducing manual recruiter workflow.

compare.pricing_model: Enterprise B2B contract/subscription (custom quote via demo request); no self-serve public pricing published.
compare.data_residency: AWS-hosted SaaS; residency specifics governed per-contract via the Data Processing Addendum, not publicly broken out.

flags: Not to be confused with HireRight, a separate background-check company with a similarly named trust center; this report covers HireVue, Inc. (hirevue.com).
The trust center lives on a separate SafeBase-hosted subdomain (trust.hirevue.com).
Whether an individual customer's candidate/interview data is used to retrain HireVue's AI models over time is not publicly stated.
The trust center's own wording 'FedRAMP Certified Class C' is nonstandard trust-center phrasing; the FedRAMP.gov Marketplace registry independently confirms Moderate-impact authorization.
